---
title: "Alaska Department of Health Header"
format: html
---

<style>
/* Define CSS variables for colors */
:root {
  --header-bg-color: #1a345a; /* A dark blue similar to the website */
  --text-color: #ffffff;
  --light-gray-text: #c0c0c0; /* For the top "The Great State of Alaska" */
}

/* Overall header container */
.website-header {
  background-color: var(--header-bg-color);
  color: var(--text-color);
  font-family: Arial, sans-serif; /* Common sans-serif font */
}

/* Top banner: "The Great State of Alaska" */
.top-banner {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 10px 20px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); /* Subtle separator */
}

.top-banner .logo-text {
  font-size: 0.8em;
  color: var(--light-gray-text);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px; /* Space between logo and text */
}

.top-banner .logo-text img {
  height: 1.5em; /* Adjust size of eagle logo */
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.top-banner .dropdown-arrow {
  font-size: 1.2em;
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* Main header: "State of Alaska Department of Health" */
.main-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 15px 20px;
}

.main-header .department-info {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 15px; /* Space between department logo and text */
}

.main-header .department-info .department-logo img {
  height: 50px; /* Adjust size of department logo */
  width: auto;
}

.main-header .department-info .department-text h1 {
  font-size: 1.8em;
  margin: 0;
  font-weight: normal;
  color: var(--text-color);
}

.main-header .menu-icon {
  font-size: 2em; /* Size for hamburger icon */
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* Basic responsiveness for smaller screens (optional, but good practice) */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .main-header .department-info {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
  }
  .main-header .department-info .department-text h1 {
    font-size: 1.5em;
  }
}
</style>

<div class="website-header">
  <div class="top-banner">
    <div class="logo-text">
      <img src="https://health.alaska.gov/PublishingImages/Alaska_State_Seal.png" alt="Alaska Eagle Logo"> The Great State of Alaska
    </div>
    <div class="dropdown-arrow">&#9660;</div> </div>

  <div class="main-header">
    <div class="department-info">
      <div class="department-logo">
        <img src="https://health.alaska.gov/PublishingImages/Alaska_State_Seal.png" alt="State of Alaska Seal Logo">
      </div>
      <div class="department-text">
        <h1>State of Alaska</h1>
        <h1>Department of Health</h1>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="menu-icon">&#9776;</div> </div>
</div>
